verdict.rationale: The evidence documents imports (cURL, OpenAPI, collections and environments), self-hosting with "full data ownership", and an MIT-licensed Community Edition. None of it describes an export feature that lets a user take all their data out in open formats. Self-hosting ownership and the MCP server's read access to collections are adjacent controls or building blocks, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
